#MSNews | The Bureau of Fire Protection mourns the untimely passing of FO2 Allier Vincent N. Catadman, 31, of San Remigio Fire Station, Cebu. 

He died in the line of duty following the collapse of the San Remigio Sports Complex during the magnitude 6.9 earthquake. 

"We honor his service, bravery, and sacrifice. Our thoughts and prayers are with his family, especially his wife and young child," the BFP said in their statement. | via Vince Lopez
